calls.reason: The forecast has no deadline. The WGA ratified a new MBA in April 2026 running to 2030, and the 2023 deal bars studios from requiring AI use. Neither event settles whether the union is 'eventually' destroyed, and no evidence of one-writer AI rooms was found.

The evidence is one company's own release (Klarna, which also says human agents remain available) plus 2023 CFPB complaint examples. Nothing longitudinal or representative shows a sustained decline in human contact or lost accountability.

WGA records show the AMPTP rejected AI limits, and TIME treats AI as one strike issue among others. Executive motives are unproven: Zitron admits he is assuming them, and the AMPTP gave a different account.

Intercom's Fin launch shows chatbots doing service conversations, and research shows they can produce empathetic-sounding replies. Whether they lack felt empathy and accountability is a characterisation the packet cannot settle.
